selected_browser_engine.document_projection: compact corpus plus reviewed locale alias groups from search-normalization-aliases-0.9.0

acceptance.scope: Every maintained locale independently; macro averages cannot hide a regression.
acceptance.false_positive_guard: Expected no-result cases must remain empty at least as often as the frozen control.

tokenization_coverage: CJK full runs, unigrams, and bigrams
network_boundary: The runner makes no network request, download, browser launch, or generated-site read. Node loads only the maintained BPM browser script.
